en: The image shows a sepia-toned photograph of a woman standing at a podium in an ornate interior, likely a parliamentary or governmental setting. She is dressed in early 20th-century attire, wearing glasses, and appears to be speaking or preparing to speak. Behind her is a large candle holder and wooden panelling, and on the podium are glass pitchers and glasses. The bottom of the image has handwritten text in Finnish.
